prompts.tier1_full: Single-edge notched shear specimen: 1 mm by 1 mm steel plate in plane strain with a 0.5 mm horizontal pre-crack from the left edge at mid-height. Bottom edge fully fixed (u_x = u_y = 0). Top edge pulled horizontally to the right (u_x) by 0.012 mm — in-plane shear loading. Material: Steel_bench_2D_PE catalog. Run 100 steps.
prompts.tier2_partial: steel plate with edge crack pulled in shear, mode-II loading
prompts.tier3_figure_only: Reproduce the curved crack path observed in the Miehe SENS benchmark (CMAME 2010 Figure 12) — a single-edge notched specimen under mode-II shear, where vol-dev split gives the WRONG path and spectral or stress-based split is required.
